name: print-social-property-post-mosaic-with-floor-plans-and-landscape-photos
title: Dark grey and white real-estate post mosaic: isometric floor plans with price pills, landscape photos and stat panels
whatItIs: A masonry mosaic of square and tall posts in charcoal, grey and white: isometric apartment floor plans with a grey price pill, misty landscape photos with a place name, construction-progress and property-management text cards, large stat blocks (up to 21%, 7.8%, 15 years) and a snowy mountain photo.
whatItMeans: Calm and credible; muted greys and 3D plans make investment content feel structured.
techniques: Show floor plans as isometric 3D on white cards.
Add price in a grey pill.
Mix landscape photos with text cards.
Use large stats on dark tiles.

vocabulary.definition: A 3D angled plan of a home.
A grey capsule with a price.
A panel with a big figure and caption.
